use: Original dated photo of Dr. Kerr’s hospital, credited to E. Warren Clark.
John Glasgow Kerr’s 1880 map of Canton, marked No. 5 for Medical Missionary Hospital at the riverfront block.
Mapped named successor hospital campus with matching identity.
Institution lists the North Campus at 107 Yanjiang West Road.
Sun Yat-sen University documents the nineteenth-century hospital’s move to the present site.
Published 1885 description by Benjamin Couch Henry of the hospital and the compound in this period.
